sectionRef: Approach > Architecture > AST mutator edited ranges
description: scripts/lib/upsert-task-edit.mjs uses zero-width insertion edits (start === end) for both array-item insertion (formatArrayInsertion) and object-entry insertion (planObjectEntryInsertion). AC6b says edited ranges should 'cover only the appended task object plus exact new map entries'. A zero-width range does not actually cover the inserted bytes, so a downstream byte-identity test that uses editedRanges to decide which bytes to compare cannot easily verify the create path. The current test in upsert-task-edit.test.ts validates the create path via idempotency-on-rerun rather than by computing outside-bytes-equal under post-insertion offsets, so the gap is in coverage rather than in observable behavior.
suggestedFix: Either (a) report insertion ranges as [insertionOffset, insertionOffset + replacement.length] in post-edit coordinates with a clearly documented coordinate-system contract; or (b) introduce a separate insertedRanges field on the result for create-style edits. Then extend upsert-task-edit.test.ts to assert outside-bytes-equal for the create path using the new range shape.
